title: Release day keeps saved names that contain the word Catalog
custom_preconds:
Setup (manual QA tester and Claude session)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as an Admin at {Location-A} (for example Staging Heavy Duty - 9919). The Admin role has 'Part Library & Inventory → View / Create & Edit / Delete'.
  • Custom role {Role-A} named "ZZAUTOTEST PL Catalog Clerk" (an example; any name with the word Catalog) was created before the deployment.
  • Inventory part {Part-A} (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PL-CATWORD-01) with the description "ZZAUTOTEST PL Catalog rack" (an example with the word Catalog) was created before the deployment.
custom_steps:
1. Open Settings, then click Roles & Permissions.
  2. Find {Role-A} in the list and read its name.
  3. In the top bar click Parts, then click Inventory in the left menu.
  4. Type {Part-A} in the Search box.
  5. Read the description of {Part-A}.
  6. Click Part Library in the left menu.
  7. Type {Part-A} in the Search box.
  8. Read the entry's description.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 2: The role still has the name it was given before the deployment, word for word, including the word Catalog.
  • Step 5: The part's description is still the one typed before the deployment, including the word Catalog.
  • Step 8: The Part Library entry's description is still the same: saved data was not renamed; only the screen's own words changed.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10647; story SV-10825 (Story 12, Call the Shared Parts List the Part Library); PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, as edited 9 Oct 2026 (Ready for dev), S12-N3, read 13 Oct 2026; design canvas: no board shows this behaviour (13 Oct copy).
